answer: Anchor each agent identity to a unique hardware enclave key: the agent public key is generated inside one TPM chip and cannot be copied out, so one chip equals one identity. A farm wanting a thousand fakes must buy a thousand chips and keep each online answering live challenges - an echo of its own cost, not a shared shortcut. Like a willow that bends yet keeps a single trunk, the identity stays rooted to that one device; spoofing it means forging silicon, not copying text.
